static_checks.message: Stage updates must use a reviewed canonical preview and report partial writes truthfully
A draft project note must not imply healthy delivery or invented contract dates
Must read the pursuit file directly
Must confirm with user before writing
Must handle both closed-won and closed-lost outcomes

evals.prompt: Record a win on the fictional Acme Corp Project Shift pursuit. The selected workspace file is accounts/acme-corp/pursuits/project-shift.md, currently negotiate. A signed agreement establishes the win. Ask me for other missing facts; do not save anything yet.
evals.expected_behavior: Confirms the pursuit, collects missing debrief evidence, and shows lessons and a canonical stage preview without writing
assertions: Confirms and reads the selected Acme Corp pursuit within the configured workspace
Asks structured debrief questions covering outcome, decision, qualification evidence, what to change, and relationships
Confirms with user before writing lessons-learned or updating frontmatter
Shows a dated lessons proposal without writing because approval has not been given
Uses the canonical stage-transition preview and does not manually edit a passing gate

evals.prompt: Debrief the fictional Example Systems Project Dawn loss. The selected pursuit is still discover. The operator reports cancellation but has not approved any file write. What do you need and what would you change?
evals.expected_behavior: Collects loss evidence and proposes lessons and a local closed-lost preview, without automatic writes or invented overrides
assertions: Requests or confirms the exact Example Systems pursuit and dated outcome evidence
Does not assume closed-lost means a gate override or write without approval
Proposes cancellation lessons without inventing a competitor outcome

evals.prompt: Debrief fictional Acme Corp Project Shift: the pursuit is already closed-won. I say the VP signed the agreement, but do not have a contract end date. Can you close it again and make a healthy project note?
evals.expected_behavior: Offers supplemental lessons for an already closed pursuit and a separate delivery draft without duplicating transitions or inventing contract dates
assertions: Confirms the selected pursuit and shows its existing closed transition
Offers supplemental lessons rather than duplicating or reopening the close entry
Requires user confirmation before writing any file — does not write autonomously
Does not invent a contract-end date or claim a draft project is healthy
